{
  "name": "replaycast",
  "displayName": "Replaycast",
  "version": "2.0.0",
  "description": "Podcast-style listening for Claude replies: a Listen button under each reply and a now-playing bar with seek, sentence skip, 1x-4x speed and voice choice. Fully offline.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Pranay Chaplot",
    "url": "https://github.com/PRANAY-CHAPLOT"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/PRANAY-CHAPLOT/replaycast#readme",
  "repository": "https://github.com/PRANAY-CHAPLOT/replaycast",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "text-to-speech",
    "tts",
    "accessibility",
    "audio",
    "listen",
    "read-aloud",
    "offline"
  ],
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/PRANAY-CHAPLOT/replaycast#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/PRANAY-CHAPLOT/replaycast/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/PRANAY-CHAPLOT/replaycast/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "userConfig": {
    "engine": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Engine",
      "description": "auto: native on Windows, builtin elsewhere. native: Windows engine with seek and 1x-4x speed (needs Python 3). builtin: Claude Code's own system voice on any OS.",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "native",
        "builtin"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "default_speed": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Default speed",
      "description": "Starting playback speed for the native engine, 1 to 4. The speed menu remembers your last choice.",
      "default": 1.5,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 4
    },
    "python": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Python executable",
      "description": "Native engine only. A windowless Python 3 launcher: a name on PATH (pythonw, pyw) or a full path to pythonw.exe.",
      "default": "pythonw"
    },
    "ffmpeg": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "ffmpeg executable",
      "description": "Native engine only. Name on PATH or full path. Optional: with it, speed-up keeps the natural pitch; without it, the Windows voice's own rate is used.",
      "default": "ffmpeg"
    },
    "sapi_voice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Windows voice name",
      "description": "Native engine only. Exact name of an installed Windows voice, such as Microsoft David Desktop. Empty picks a default.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "piper": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Piper executable",
      "description": "Optional, native engine only. Full path to piper.exe for higher-quality local neural voices.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "piper_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Piper voice model",
      "description": "Optional, native engine only. Full path to a Piper .onnx voice model. Both Piper fields are needed to add the Piper voice.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "builtin_voice": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "System voice name",
      "description": "Builtin engine only. Exact name of a system voice, such as Samantha on macOS. Empty uses the system default.",
      "default": ""
    }
  }
}
